bullets.text: New Developer Resource Page - **Microsoft** enhances interoperability for **Microsoft 365** applications with a new developer resource page.
Passkey Syncing in Edge - **Microsoft Edge** now allows secure passkey saving and syncing across devices for easier logins.
Novel Backdoor Discovered - **Microsoft** researchers uncover a backdoor using the **OpenAI** API for command-and-control communications.
GitHub Universe Highlights - **GitHub** showcases innovations in developer collaboration and AI integration at the annual event.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New features and updates are rolling out for **Windows 11** Insiders in the Dev and Beta Channels.
AI Security Threats E-Book - **Microsoft** releases a guide detailing five generative AI security threats organizations must know.
AI Evaluation Libraries - **Microsoft** introduces libraries to evaluate AI applications, ensuring quality and reliability.
Expanded Edge Security - **Microsoft Edge** enhances user protection with an expanded scareware blocker and real-time protection.
Immersive Productivity with Meta - **Microsoft** and **Meta** launch tools for enhanced productivity in mixed reality environments.
AI Advancements with NVIDIA - **Microsoft** and **NVIDIA** announce new AI capabilities to enhance cloud and edge computing.
